usage: music-tagger nd set-rating [-h] [--from FROM_FILE] [--dry-run]

Push ratings and stars from JSON back into Navidrome.

options:
  -h, --help        show this help message and exit
  --from FROM_FILE  Ratings JSON (default:
                    /mnt/synology/media/music/ratings.json).
  --dry-run         Show what would be set without making changes.
